title: Motion+ 20% off for Black Friday 2026
summary_en: Motion+ is a one-time payment for lifetime updates. For this year's Black Friday, there's a massive 20% discount. When we launched Motion+ "lifetime updates" was an easy promise to make. But, Motion+ is almost two years old now. We can look back and ask, if you bought it way back when, what would you have received over the last year - entirely for free? Quite a lot, it turns out. With more on the horizon. Read the full article on Motion
